title: `PrettyPrinter::header` does not display a header
author: cstyles
body:
<!--

Hey there, thank you for reporting a bug!

Please note that the following bugs have already been reported:

* dpkg: error processing archive /some/path/some-program.deb (--unpack):
  trying to overwrite '/usr/.crates2.json'

  See https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/issues/938

-->

### **What steps will reproduce the bug?**

Compile and run the following program:

```rust
fn main() {
    bat::PrettyPrinter::new()
        .input_file("Cargo.toml")
        .header(true)
        .print()
        .unwrap();
}
```

### **What happens?**

The file is printed without a header.

### **What did you expect to happen instead?**

The file would be printed with a header containing the filename.

### **How did you install `bat`?**

Via cargo:

```toml
[dependencies]
bat = "0.22.1"
```

---

It looks like the issue is due to the fact that there exist both "header filename" and "header filesize" style components. `PrettyPrinter::header` adds `StyleComponent::Header` to the list of components:

https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/blob/f215d07366dac50aa7068e9c3f8d5f46b09b4c1a/src/pretty_printer.rs#L279-L281

But when the components are checked, `bat` only looks for `StyleComponent::HeaderFilename` or `StyleComponent::HeaderFilesize`:

https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/blob/f215d07366dac50aa7068e9c3f8d5f46b09b4c1a/src/style.rs#L109-L119

I'm not sure what the best way to tackle this would be. Should we also check for `StyleComponent::Header` in `StyleComponents::header`? Should the `PrettyPrinter::header` function push in `StyleComponent::HeaderFilename`? Should `PrettyPrinter` expose a `header_filename(bool)` function?
